c: This article primarily features content only available in DLC, which may not be available in all copies of the game.
Abyss Foscari is the second stage in the Tides of the Foscari DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked after breaking the green crystal (Seal of the Lake) in
Sealed by Luminaire in ancient times to contain the darkness within, these underground ruins are now accessible, but so is the outside world to the evil from the depths.
The hyper mode for this stage can be unlocked by defeating the Je-Ne-Viv in normal mode.
Hyper mode in Abyss Foscari has a +100%

c: Stepping on one of the small black circles on the ground triggers an unavoidable map event, chosen at random between 11 predetermined options. The traps have a 20 second cooldown before they can be triggered again.
The event summons 40 Lost Heads in an elliptic shape around the player. They cannot move, fire every 2 s, have a max health of 25.
The event summons Lost Head 2s, which fire every 1.5 s and have a max health of 150.
The event summons Rellyfishes in an elliptic shape around the player.
The event spawns a group of Swarm Rotting Ghouls, which sweep in a straight line across the map and can push other enemies along them.
The event spawns a group of Blood Mosses, which sweep in a straight line across the map and can push other enemies along them.
The event spawns a group of Burning Skulls, which sweep in a straight line across the map and can push other enemies along them.
This event is the same as above, appearing a second time in the list of events.
